title.suggested: Coburn and Allen to Spar at Mozart Hall Exhibition

summary.suggested: The Daily Missouri Democrat announced a sparring exhibition at Mozart Hall, with Joe Coburn, Tom Allen, Mike McCoole and Tom Kelly expected, and a wind-up between Coburn and Allen in ring costume.

metadata.notes: Page is the Daily Democrat of Monday April 25, 1870 (same page image as 393), but the item says the exhibition is 'to-morrow night', and 395/396 show it was held Monday night April 25. The item probably ran on Sunday April 24; I could not find it on the scaled page to confirm. Current title/summary describe the Wash Home article (393), not this item.

facts.fact: Allen was billed to spar Joe Coburn in ring costume as the wind-up of a sparring exhibition at Mozart Hall, St. Louis

notes: Check the source date: 'to-morrow night' suggests the April 24 paper.
